name: follow-through
description: Stop coding agents losing unfinished work: a task tree on disk that survives pivots and context compaction, with evidence-gated closing and opt-in hooks that bring open work back into view. By Lex from SigmaStudioz.

interface.longDescription: For developers using a coding agent who want a local record of unfinished project work. Use the bundled Python command-line tool to add tasks with completion criteria, record status and evidence, park work with a next step, and list open tasks. Records are stored in a local JSON file and can be read when a conversation resumes. Optional hooks, configured separately by the owner in a supported host, can show open-task reminders and request one continuation when the agent stops. These reminders depend on the host configuration and recorded tasks; they do not ensure every request is captured or completed. The package has no publisher backend and makes no network requests.
defaultPrompt: Put this plan on the task tree before you start.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: disk task tree with evidence-gated closing, parked pivots, session-scoped stop check and fail-open Claude Code hooks.
